findings: Kumar Table 3 contains 40 structures in 28 nuclei; the inventory counts A=7, B=9, C=22, D=2 under an explicit local evidence rubric.
Tier A direct evidence is concentrated in 104Pd, 105Cd, 106Cd bands 2/3, 107Cd bands 1/2, and 108Cd; Tier B includes 100/101/103Pd, 109/110Cd, and 142/143Eu.

Delta-I=2 cascades, calculated J2/BE2, or TAC/SCM assignments dominate the C/D population; 144Dy remains a low-confidence candidate with pi h11/2^2 x nu h11/2^-2 and no tabulated BE2/lifetime evidence.

Cd uses pi(g9/2)^-2 holes with h11/2, g7/2, d5/2 neutron alignment; Pd mixes effective pi(g9/2)^-2 and higher-hole configurations, while 104Pd PNC four-hole geometry is not an independent-blade wavefunction; Dy is a structurally different same-high-j particle-hole candidate.
